pages.text: $(l)Immersive Melodies$(): craft an instrument (lute, flute, piano, trumpet, bagpipe, drum and more), hold it and right-click to pick a song.$(br2)Play one of the built-in songs, or free-play notes with your keyboard. Everyone nearby hears it, so start a band!
Drop your own $(l).midi$() or $(l).abc$() song files onto the song list to add them.
